basic_info.description: Welcome to this enchanting 3 bed, 2 bath single-family home in San Francisco's coveted Outer Richmond Districtdesigned by famed architect Oliver Rousseau, whose fairytale-style homes are beloved for their whimsical lines, rounded archways, and romantic European influences.   Set among a row of Rousseau's signature homes, this residence blends architectural charm with modern comforts. Step inside to find graceful curved ceilings, hardwood floors, and a sun-drenched living room anchored by a grand fireplace. Hand painted wooden beams run across the vaulted ceiling in the living room. A bright, updated kitchen leads to a formal dining room perfect for entertaining.  The home's location offers the best of San Francisco living: just minutes from Golden Gate Park, Ocean Beach, Land's End, and walking distance to world-class restaurants on Balboa and Clement Streets from Vietnamese to Egyptian cuisine. Enjoy weekend bike rides along the coast, garden strolls in Golden Gate Park, or a picnic on the beach with an ocean view.   Whether you're drawn by the architectural pedigree or the vibrant, nature-filled surroundings, this home is a rare opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco history in one of its most peaceful and picturesque neighborhoods.
